Our Story
Why Norman
exists.
A parent. A moment. An invention.
I manage anxiety. My nervous system has always needed a little more than the world typically offers — more weight, more movement, more sensation, more time.
It started during a long performance. I was wearing a vibration device to help regulate my nervous system when the thought came: what if Norman could do this too? What if squeezing him meant feeling vibration back?
That instinct has a name — co-regulation. When we hold someone we love, our nervous systems synchronize. The science of calm through connection.
I went home and started building. The moment I squeezed the first prototype and felt it vibrate back, something clicked. It answered me.
"I'm allowed to be different. I'm allowed to be me. And I'm proud of how I'm wired."
Norman is for everyone whose nervous system needs more — children who need something that holds them back, adults quietly managing what nobody else can see.
Built by someone who understands — not from a textbook, but from lived experience.
Embrace your calm.
— Suz Tocco, Founder · CalmCompanion™
